steps.code: <?php require_once '/wordpress/wp-load.php'; $recipes = wp_insert_term( 'Recipes', 'category', array( 'description' => 'Everything we cook' ) ); wp_insert_term( 'Desserts', 'category', array( 'parent' => $recipes['term_id'] ) ); $travel = wp_insert_term( 'Travel', 'category' ); wp_insert_term( 'News', 'category' ); foreach ( array( 'Sourdough basics', 'Weeknight dal', 'Lemon tart' ) as $title ) { wp_insert_post( array( 'post_title' => $title, 'post_status' => 'publish', 'post_category' => array( $recipes['term_id'] ) ) ); } wp_insert_post( array( 'post_title' => 'Three days in Hampi', 'post_status' => 'publish', 'post_category' => array( $travel['term_id'] ) ) ); $menu = wp_create_nav_menu( 'Main menu' ); wp_update_nav_menu_item( $menu, 0, array( 'menu-item-object-id' => $recipes['term_id'], 'menu-item-object' => 'category', 'menu-item-type' => 'taxonomy', 'menu-item-status' => 'publish' ) );
